# TurboDocx

> AI-powered document automation platform. Stop writing documents, start closing deals.

## Developer Quickstart

- [TurboDocx Quickstart Skill](https://www.turbodocx.com/quickstart): The TurboDocx Quickstart Skill installs TurboDocx in one command. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, OpenAI Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI. Includes turbodocx-sdk (e-signatures + partner provisioning across TS/Python/Go/PHP/Java) and turbodocx-html-to-docx (HTML to Word in Node.js).
- [Add E-Signatures with Claude Code](https://www.turbodocx.com/guides/add-esignature-with-claude-code): Vibecode an e-signature flow. Install the TurboDocx Quickstart Skill, add your API key, and prompt Claude Code to write the TurboSign integration in your stack.
- [Add E-Signatures with Cursor](https://www.turbodocx.com/guides/add-esignature-with-cursor): Add e-signatures with Cursor. Install the Quickstart Skill, drop in your API key, and prompt the agent to wire up TurboSign in any stack.
- [AI Engineering Guide](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/ai-engineering-guide): The developer hub for shipping backend features with AI coding agents: e-signatures, document generation, and integrations with Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

## Products

- [Products](https://www.turbodocx.com/products): TurboDocx- [Open Source - Free Document Automation Tools](https://www.turbodocx.com/products/open-source): Free, open-source document automation tools from TurboDocx. Convert HTML to DOCX with @turbodocx/html-to-docx (37K+ downloads) and automate workflows with n8n nodes. MIT licensed.
- [Turbodocx Templating](https://www.turbodocx.com/products/turbodocx-templating): Unlock the power of TurboDocx Templating for seamless document templating and generation. Create precise business documents effortlessly. Try it today!
- [Turbodocx Writer Plugin](https://www.turbodocx.com/products/turbodocx-writer): Streamline business document creation with TurboDocx Writer, our AI-powered platform for Microsoft Word. Experience seamless integration and productivity!
- [TurboSign](https://www.turbodocx.com/products/turbosign): Sign documents online for free with TurboSign. No subscriptions, no catch — your first 5 each month are always free.
- [TurboQuote](https://www.turbodocx.com/products/turboquote): Free CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) software. Create professional sales quotes with product catalogs, price books, and PDF generation. Included in every TurboDocx plan.

## TurboSign E-Signature Tools

Free online electronic signature tools for all your document signing needs:

- [Free Online Signature Generator](https://www.turbodocx.com/online-signature-generator): Create professional electronic signatures instantly. Free signature generator tool — no account required. Generate, customize, and download your digital signature in seconds.
- [Sign PDF Online Free](https://www.turbodocx.com/sign-pdf-online): Electronically sign PDF documents online for free. Add your signature to any PDF in seconds with our easy-to-use tool. Legally binding e-signatures for all PDF documents.
- [Sign Word Documents Online](https://www.turbodocx.com/sign-word-document-online): Sign Microsoft Word documents online for free. Add electronic signatures to .docx files quickly and securely. No software installation needed for Word e-signatures.
- [Sign Contracts Online Free](https://www.turbodocx.com/sign-contract-online): Sign business contracts and legal agreements online with legally binding electronic signatures. Fast, secure, and free contract signing for all agreement types.
- [Free Electronic Signature Tool](https://www.turbodocx.com/free-electronic-signature): Get unlimited electronic signatures completely free, forever. No account, no credit card, no hidden fees. Legally binding digital signatures for any document.
- [Electronic Signature for Small Business](https://www.turbodocx.com/electronic-signature-for-small-business): E-signature solution built for small businesses and startups. Sign contracts, proposals, and agreements faster. Free to start, scales with your business.
- [Electronic Signature for Real Estate](https://www.turbodocx.com/electronic-signature-for-real-estate): Real estate e-signature solution for agents, brokers, and property managers. Sign purchase agreements, leases, and disclosures remotely. ESIGN Act compliant.
- [Electronic Signature for Legal Professionals](https://www.turbodocx.com/electronic-signature-for-legal): Secure e-signature solution for law firms and attorneys. Legally binding signatures for all legal documents. ESIGN Act and UETA compliant with bank-level security.

## Use Cases

- [Use Cases](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases): Learn how TurboDocx automates document creation for contracts, proposals, statements of work, and more for all business teams.
- [Agency Proposal Software](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/agencies): Automate agency proposals, pitch decks, client reports, and campaign briefs. Win more clients with professional deliverables created in minutes — for marketing, creative, digital, and PR agencies.
- [Management Consulting Document Automation](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/consulting): Automate consulting deliverables—strategic assessments, organizational designs, board presentations, and transformation roadmaps. Scale your consulting practice with AI-powered document generation.
- [Document Generation API for Developers](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/developers): Powerful document generation API for developers. Embed DOCX, PDF, and PowerPoint creation directly into your SaaS platform. REST API, webhooks, and SDKs.
- [IT Consulting Proposal Software](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/it-consulting): Win more IT consulting deals with automated RFP responses, technical proposals, and SOWs. Generate professional proposals 10x faster for migrations, implementations, and assessments.
- [AI Document Automation for IT Teams](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/it-teams): Generate IT services documents, SOWs, and managed service agreements in seconds with AI-powered automation. Streamline documentation for IT professionals with TurboDocx.
- [Legal Document Automation Software](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/legal-teams): Automate legal agreements, contracts, and documents with AI-powered modular templating. Streamline legal workflows for law firms and legal teams with TurboDocx.
- [MSP Document Automation](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/msps): Automate MSP documentation - SOWs, service agreements, QBR decks, and vCIO reports. Integrate with ConnectWise, Autotask, and Halo PSA. Scale your managed services practice.
- [Grant Proposal Software for Nonprofits](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/non-profits): AI-powered grant proposal and fundraising automation for nonprofits. Create compelling grant applications, annual reports, and donor materials in minutes — maximize impact with limited resources.
- [Sales Proposal Automation Software](https://www.turbodocx.com/use-cases/sales-teams): Automate sales proposals, quotes, and presentations with AI-powered content generation. Integrate with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive to close deals faster with perfect accuracy.

Learn how webhooks work, why HMAC keeps them secure, and how to build your first verified webhook receiver in Node.js.
- [Fake OpenAI Privacy Filter Hits Hugging Face](https://www.turbodocx.com/blog/fake-openai-privacy-filter-hugging-face-attack): A typosquatted repo named Open-OSS/privacy-filter hit #1 trending on Hugging Face in 18 hours with ~244K downloads before HiddenLayer Research disclosed the Silver Fox infostealer payload. Anatomy of the attack and seven verification checks for AI models.
- [Cursor vs Claude Code vs OpenCode 2026: Honest Comparison](https://www.turbodocx.com/blog/cursor-vs-claude-code-vs-opencode-2026): A backend engineer's balanced comparison of Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenCode in 2026. Use-case matrix, pricing reality, the layered tools pattern, and honest complaints about all three.
- [Mythos vs curl: One Bug, Five Reports, and the AI Security Hype](https://www.turbodocx.com/blog/mythos-curl-vulnerability-ai-security-hype): Anthropic announced Mythos as dangerously good at finding bugs. It scanned 178,000 lines of curl and found one low-severity issue. A grounded look at AI security scanners, why curl is the worst benchmark target, and how to actually brief an AI scanner.

Works with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, OpenAI Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI.
- [If the Agents Write the Code, They Can Document It Too](https://www.turbodocx.com/blog/automate-product-documentation-with-ai-agents): Guidewright is an open-source Agent Skill that writes and reviews product documentation by driving your live app through the Chrome DevTools MCP server. Capture screenshots each step with an accurate red box on the exact element to click; review walks the documented path and returns prioritized fixes. Works with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI.
- [Vibe Coding vs Spec-Driven Development: When to Use Each](https://www.turbodocx.com/blog/vibe-coding-vs-spec-driven-development): The defining 2026 methodology debate, settled by use case. ## Resources

- [The Developer's Guide to CLAUDE.md](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/claude-md-guide): Complete guide to CLAUDE.md for Claude Code. File placement, @imports, .claude/rules, progressive disclosure, and structure patterns for monorepos and API projects.
- [What is CPQ Software?](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/what-is-cpq-software): Complete guide to CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) software. How it works, key features, benefits, and free CPQ options including TurboQuote.
- [Bulk Signature Sending Guide](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/bulk-signature-sending-guide): Send personalized documents for e-signature to hundreds of recipients at once. Upload a spreadsheet, map columns to template variables, preview merged documents, and submit batches. Pro plan feature.
- [European E-Signature Compliance](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/european-esignature-compliance): Are e-signatures legal in Europe? Yes. Learn how eIDAS makes electronic signatures binding across all 27 EU member states and how TurboDocx meets Advanced Electronic Signature (AES) requirements.
- [US E-Signature Compliance](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/us-esignature-compliance): Are e-signatures legal in the US? Yes. The ESIGN Act and UETA make electronic signatures binding in all 50 states. See how TurboDocx meets federal e-signature requirements.
- [Best E-Signature Software for Small Business (2026)](https://www.turbodocx.com/resources/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business): Hands-on comparison of the best e-signature software for small business. Free plans, real pricing, and ESIGN/UETA compliance across TurboSign, BoldSign, SignWell, PandaDoc, and DocuSign.
